title: Concept: Clockwork debug toolbar disclosed
description: The Clockwork toolbar is injected into the response, so the Clockwork profiler is enabled and its request metadata is reachable.
applicability: Responses rendered by a PHP application with Clockwork enabled.
risk: The toolbar links a profiler that stores request timelines, SQL and log entries, which map application behaviour; MEDIUM because the toolbar itself does not prove the profile store is public.
